The vendor directly providing the **Headspace** platform at **headspace.com** is **Headspace, Inc.**

### Provider Statement
According to the official **Headspace Terms & Conditions** on `headspace.com`:
> *"Headspace, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates (“Headspace,” “us” or “we”) provides content and products via: www.headspace.com (the “Website”), our applications (the “Apps”), or other delivery methods (the Website, the Apps and such content and products are collectively the “Product”)."*

record.description: Headspace is a mental health platform that offers accessible support through its app, which features a variety of tools including guided meditations, sleepcasts, and mindfulness exercises. Catering to both individuals and enterprises, Headspace enhances well-being with mental health coaching and integrated services like Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), therapy, and psychiatry. With a diverse team of experts, the company aims to improve mental health for millions globally.
